'''1999 GenCon Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 8 August 1999. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d14">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99d14/ gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 20 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99d14/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Team Event Format]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Jim Li Very Long Gen Con Report Wisconsin 8-7-99 (tournament report)]] — by [[Jim Li]], 12th (individual), 3–1

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Jim Li writes that all his teammates lost the second game; Mike Fitzgerald reports his own game 2 as a timed-out true tie.<ref name="tr-d14" />
* Jim Li writes that all his teammates lost the second game; Mike Fitzgerald reports his own game 2 as a timed-out true tie.<ref name="tr-d29" />
